landing.faq.title: Questions before you pin
landing.faq.support: Short answers about the map thread — planning, roads, and what travels with you.
landing.faq.softSupport: Soft FAQ — read on this page while trips and live maps wait.
landing.faq.softOffline: You are offline — FAQ answers stay on this page; trips and live maps wait until you reconnect. Never a Failed to fetch crash.
landing.faq.q1.question: What is Beaver Plan?
landing.faq.q1.answer: A map-first travel OS — pin places, shape walkable days, journal, share cards, and translate on the street from the same trip thread.
landing.faq.q2.question: Do routes follow real roads?
landing.faq.q2.answer: Yes. Itinerary polylines use road and path geometry from the map engine — never straight stop-to-stop chords.
landing.faq.q3.question: Can friends co-edit a trip?
landing.faq.q3.answer: Invite companions as owner, editor, or viewer. Comments and a quiet activity timeline keep the same map thread in sync.
landing.faq.q4.question: Which map engines are supported?
landing.faq.q4.answer: Google by default; mainland China auto-switches to Amap. Settings let you override, including Baidu when you need it.
landing.faq.q5.question: Is live translate part of the product?
landing.faq.q5.answer: Yes — two-way talk plus dual-camera captions when the language on the corner shifts, with zh-CN / en i18n throughout.
landing.faq.q6.question: What works when you are offline?
landing.faq.q6.answer: Pin a trip cache for days, stops, journal text, and last-known route lines. Journal notes queue and flush when you reconnect — full vendor tile packs are not downloaded.
